acceptanceCriteria: Measured package time before and after, or a recorded finding that the builds are not material
body: Reported by a read-only review 2026-10-18 (not timed): cmd/corvint/record_fresh_test.go:16 and transport_recovery_test.go:59 run go build without sync.Once; work_adopt_test.go:54,66 build two more variants; work capture fixtures run nested go build. cmd/corvint costs about 586 s in .github/cishards/package-costs.json. Expected: tests needing the plain build share one binary built once (TestMain or sync.Once); measure before and after.
title: Suspected: cmd/corvint tests build the corvint binary several times per package run with no shared once
